content: Nohinaeharenae, Wiyekohase Jesus Cristo tyoaneneheta, exahe wiyahohisakakoatyoane ekakoa akiti wirae xikakoa:

Awa atyo xiyahekola xexawareharetya haxerore, exahe hoka awa atyo ximawaiyehare haiyaharenae: “Koxaka Xekohaseti haikoaheta”, nehena hoka. Xoana iraiti semasehare xamani, xoana Iraiti Waiyexe xakaisasehare xamani iraehena, xoana wiyairala xamani aohena hoka awa atyo xityakeko.

Awa atyo nikare maoserahena xiso hoka xityakekohena. Hiyaiya, Xekohaseti kaokeneheta nahititaite halitinae kahalakoahare Enore kakoa hoka Iniyalahare Nomasehare aokahitere kaotyaka. Hatyo haliti atyo irikati mawakenehare koni xetare terota.

Tyotya Enore kaxaokakiterehare nahalakoahare ite tyaona, exahe xoalini hare Enore anere kaxaokakiterehare nahalakoahare ite tyaona. Tyotya xoalini hare xahehare ite tyaona aokowi hoka xane isoa Enore hanako hoka Enore aokowihena.
Xoana maisa xotyare? Tyotya hatyoharenae noxakai xihiye notyaonitatere xihaliya xowaka.
Xakore hoka xoalini hare talaitene hoka maisa kalini aliyakere kaotyakere hoka hatyohare waiyekehalakita xomana. Hoka ekaotyakene xowakaite hatyo Iniyalahare Nomasehare kaotyakehena.
Hoka Metaharexe Iniyalahare aokahitere koxaka kaotyakehena. Xakore hoka kaotyaka aokowitere ite kaotyaka, kakikisaka hotohare ite haware hatyo talaiterene hoka.
Hatyaoseta ite Iniyalahare Nomasehare kaotyakehena hoka Xekohaseti Jesus haiyatere kakoa haikoahetehenere xowaka ite haxaohomane kakoa ite aisene, exahe mawenekoaretene ite haxaokanala kakoa.
Iniyalahare Nomasehare ite kaotyaka Ahalakoahaliti niyatere kakoa hoka tyotya xoalini hare mawaiyakahare tyomehena katyakekotyaka maheta. Maoseratya ite halitinae tyaonaha ekoamaniya maheta.

Tyotya xoalini hare iniyalahare kakoa ite maoserahena halitinae irikati mawakenehare xetarenai. Hoka wainiha ite, maisa atyo tyakekoahitaha, exahe awaiyetyahitaha Iraiti Waiyexe iniyalahare nonitata niyasehareheta hoka.
Hatyo hiyeta Enore halakisahene, maoserare aeroretyoa ihiyeha hoka maoserare tyakekoha maheta.
Hatyo harenae hiyeta ite tyotya Iraiti Waiyexe matyakekoneharenae, exahe maoseratyati xema taita tyaonitereharenae mawenekoaretyaka aoka Enore.

Nohinaeharenae, wihalahareta menita Enore kakoa xihiyeta, Xekohaseti awaiyetita xiso hoka. Hiyaiya, xiso hotohare Enore aoka haomana Isekohaliti Waiyexe niyatere hiyeta, exahe hoka Iraiti Waiyexe xityakekone hiyeta. Nikare tyoma ekaxaikone hotyalihare xisaona maheta.
Enore aoka xiso haomana nikare xisaona maheta, wiyakaihenere Iraiti Waiyexe xihiye hiyeta hoka xiyane xikaoka Wiyekohase Jesus Cristo waikohera waiyexe nali maheta.
Hiyeta hoka nohinaeharenae, maika xikinatere xisaona Xekohaseti koamaniya, exahe heko iraiti wiyakaihenere waxairahenere xomana xotyaxematya.
Wiyekohase Jesus Cristo awaiyitita wiso, Wexe Enore hoka awaiyetita wiso. Hoka hawaiyexehare hiyeta mamairanehaliti matyotenehare isa womana, exahe hoka heko wikinatere watyaha exahita maheta.
Kasani Xekohaseti Jesus, Wexe Enore aihalanalinikisa xiso waowita, exahe kahinaetya xiso hoka waiyexe taita xirae, xisoma taita.
